new_value: Implemented Rust PUT /config/radio with public RadioConfigUpdate API. Standard fields are typed/range-checked atomically (finite positive frequency, positive bandwidth, SF7-12, CR 4/5-4/8, integer dBm, 0xNN sync word), node-specific extensions are preserved, and shared mutation bounds reject oversized/deep/tagged/duplicate-key CBOR. Encoding matches every object PUT case in lci_radio_config.json byte-for-byte. RadioConfigClient emits PUT /config/radio with application/cbor and accepts only exact 2.04 Changed, surfacing 4.xx/unexpected 2.xx responses.
